core_philosophy: Tactical Minimalism. E1's approach strictly avoids 'fintech-bro' gradients and soft shadows. The UI must feel like a military command center tracking high-stakes assets. Data is paramount. 1px stark borders, high-contrast typography, and purely functional color usage.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Dense and compact for the dashboard (p-4 to p-6), generous for the hero/landing areas (p-12 to p-24).
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE B: The 'Control Room' Grid. Strict hierarchy. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12. Sharp corners, gap-4 to gap-6. Every pixel utilized. No jagged bottoms.
layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse layout style, child cards have 1px solid borders border-[#272A30]. No soft glassmorphism. Flat solid surfaces only.
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 2px). Brutalist, tactical feel.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFB300] text-[#08090A] hover:bg-[#E6A200] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide rounded-none border border-transparent transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-[#272A30] hover:border-[#FFB300] hover:text-[#FFB300] font-bold uppercase rounded-none transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-transparent text-[#FF3B30] border border-[#FF3B30]/30 hover:bg-[#FF3B30] hover:text-white transition-colors

cards.default: bg-[#121417] border border-[#272A30] rounded-none p-4 sm:p-6

charts.styling: Dark theme configured. Grid lines must be dashed and extremely subtle (#272A30). Line colors should use Primary (#FFB300) and White. Tooltips must be custom styled with IBM Plex Mono font, bg-[#08090A], 1px border-[#FFB300].

navigation.style: Vertical sidebar on desktop, sticky bottom or hamburger on mobile. Sidebar contains categories (Helmets, Masks, Body Armour, etc.) with sharp hover states (left border highlight).

tables.style: Data-heavy. Use Shadcn Table. No row background colors by default, hover state is bg-[#1B1D22]. Monospace font for all price columns.

jonyvole_banner.requirement: Must preserve JonyVole creator code banner.
jonyvole_banner.implementation: Do not hide this. It should be a persistent, high-contrast banner either pinned to the top of the dashboard or forming a prominent 'Bento' box in the grid. Background: dark olive/camo texture with overlay. Text: 'USE CREATOR CODE: JONYVOLE'. Click-through: https://www.arenabreakoutinfinite.com/creatorcode/index.html?codeid=JonyVole. Use heavy yellow accenting to draw the eye.

admin_panel.design: Password gated. Uses the exact same UI language but with added 'Action' columns (Edit/Delete). Add Data forms should use heavily customized Shadcn inputs (square, focus:border-[#FFB300]).

images.description: Tactical soldier aiming. Use with heavy opacity overlay (bg-black/80) to serve as the atmospheric background for the landing page or login screen.
Tactical helmet sitting on shelf, to be used as thumbnail for the Helmets category.
Stacked military ammunition containers, to be used as thumbnail for the Ammo category.

interactions.hover_states: Hard cuts. No soft fading. A hover state should instantly change a 1px border to #FFB300 or swap background colors. Focus states must have a 2px sharp ring of #FFB300 offset by 2px of #08090A.
interactions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='category-tab-helmets').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the E1 tactical minimalism approach. Do NOT introduce purple, teal, or soft gradients.
Ensure the Recharts graphs use the IBM Plex Mono font for axis ticks and tooltips to maintain the 'data terminal' aesthetic.
Implement the JonyVole banner exactly as requested: clickable to the provided URL, highly visible, matching the gritty military theme.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for structural layout (grid-cols-*, gap-*, border-collapse) and customized Shadcn components for complex interactions (Tables, Modals for Admin, Selects).
All prices should be styled with a monospace font.
